bullets.id: Emas sempat rebound pada Rabu setelah empat sesi turun: Kitco mencatat emas di sekitar $4.141,01, naik 0,66%, setelah sempat jatuh ke $4.116, terendah sejak 15 Oktober, menurut Vibiznews. Kamis pagi kenaikan itu terhapus: Trading Economics mencatat emas turun 0,55% ke $4.118,53 karena ketegangan baru di Timur Tengah mendorong minyak naik.
bullets.en: Gold rebounded on Wednesday after four losing sessions: Kitco had gold near $4,141.01, up 0.66%, after a dip to $4,116, the lowest since October 15, according to Vibiznews. By Thursday morning the gain was gone: Trading Economics shows gold down 0.55% at $4,118.53 as renewed Middle East tensions pushed oil higher.

bullets.id: Brent ditutup di sekitar $108,82 dan WTI $97,15 pada Rabu, lalu naik lagi Kamis. Yield 10 tahun di sekitar 5,09% dan indeks dolar sekitar 101,64. Pasar memperkirakan peluang kenaikan suku bunga Fed pada Desember sekitar 89–94%, dan sekitar 17% untuk rapat 27–28 Oktober. Emas turun sekitar 4% sebulan dan sekitar 26,6% di bawah rekor $5.608,35.
bullets.en: Brent closed near $108.82 and WTI at $97.15 on Wednesday, then rose again on Thursday. The 10-year yield is near 5.09% and the dollar index near 101.64. Markets put the odds of a December Fed hike at about 89–94%, and about 17% for the October 27–28 meeting. Gold is down about 4% on the month and about 26.6% below its $5,608.35 record.

bullets.id: Level dari Kitco: resistance $4.142,52 dan $4.162, lalu $4.180 dan $4.217; support $4.127,10 dan $4.098,63, lalu $4.066 dan $3.942. Data Rabu masih lemah: pending home sales September turun 7,3%. Agenda: klaim pengangguran (Kamis), PMI awal Oktober dan sentimen konsumen final (Jumat), lalu rapat Fed 27–28 Oktober.
bullets.en: Kitco’s levels: resistance at $4,142.52 and $4,162, then $4,180 and $4,217; support at $4,127.10 and $4,098.63, then $4,066 and $3,942. Wednesday’s data were weak again: September pending home sales fell 7.3%. Agenda: jobless claims (Thursday), preliminary October PMIs and final consumer sentiment (Friday), then the October 27–28 Fed meeting.

bullets.id: Antam turun Rp4.000 ke Rp2.550.000/gram dengan buyback Rp2.365.000 (spread sekitar 7,3%), penurunan hari ketiga. Galeri24 turun ke Rp2.504.000 (buyback Rp2.358.000, spread sekitar 5,8%) dan UBS ke Rp2.528.000 (buyback Rp2.332.000, spread sekitar 7,8%). Vibiznews mencatat permintaan fisik tetap kuat, termasuk penjualan perak dan platinum yang mencetak rekor.
bullets.en: Antam fell Rp4,000 to Rp2,550,000/gram with a Rp2,365,000 buyback (spread about 7.3%), a third daily decline. Galeri24 fell to Rp2,504,000 (buyback Rp2,358,000, spread about 5.8%) and UBS to Rp2,528,000 (buyback Rp2,332,000, spread about 7.8%). Vibiznews notes that physical demand stays strong, including record silver and platinum sales.
